$comment: Ingredient database seeding the `foods` table. Values are per 100 g of the EDIBLE PORTION, raw unless the name says otherwise -- the app converts with nutrient = grams * per100g / 100. NOTE the `foods` table stores macros PER SERVING, so the seeder must scale each per100g block by defaultServing.grams / 100 on insert. Sources: USDA FoodData Central and McCance & Widdowson. `source: curated` distinguishes these from rows later imported from Open Food Facts, which arrive with an externalId (barcode) and an imageUrl.
disclaimer: dietaryTags are derived from the ingredient's composition alone. halal and kosher in particular depend on sourcing, slaughter and certification, none of which this data captures -- never present them to a member as a guarantee.
